mysql -u root -p < schema.sql

docker-compose down

Manual test: http://localhost:8080 (Docker), http://localhost/ (local). Plain PHP; no test framework.

PHP: PascalCase classes; class files exactly match class names. Controllers end `Controller`; singular entity models. camelCase methods/properties/variables; UPPER_SNAKE_CASE constants; snake_case DB names; lowercase_underscore views. Use `require_once` with `__DIR__`; dependencies at file top:
require_once __DIR__ . '/../config/database.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../models/User.php';
4 spaces, braces as specified, spaces after keywords, no trailing whitespace, blank lines between methods; 120-char soft limit. No strict types; type hints when appropriate. PDO::FETCH_ASSOC; PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION; UTF-8. Singleton Database; handle connection errors with try-catch.

Always validate and sanitize user input. Always wrap database operations in try-catch; catch specific exceptions when possible (PDOException); models throw generic exceptions to controllers. Collect validation errors in an array; Never expose raw database errors to users.
$stmt = $this->db->prepare('...');
throw new Exception('Record already exists');
SQL: Always use prepared statements with PDO, never concatenate queries. Always include/filter by user_id for data isolation. Use lastInsertId(); rowCount(); return arrays for single records, arrays of arrays for multiple.

Always escape output with htmlspecialchars(). Passwords: password_hash()/password_verify(), never md5/sha1. Start/destroy sessions with session_start()/session_destroy(); authenticate via $_SESSION['user_id']; never store passwords in session. Redirect with header('Location: ...') then exit; CSRF not implemented, recommended for production.

Controllers check $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'], validate before processing, use models, authenticate before processing; redirect on success, render view on failure. Views include layout, use controller variables, ??, semantic HTML; no business logic. Start session in index.php; store user ID and username after login; destroy on logout. Use trim(), validate email/length, in_array() for enum values; enums stored as strings.

Feature workflow: update `schema.sql`; add model in `models/`, controller in `controllers/`, views in `views/`; route in `index.php`; optionally update `public/css/style.css`; test success/error paths.

Runtime: PHP 8.2/Apache, MySQL 8.0; env DB credentials; live-code volume; containers web/db; ports 8080/3306.
